asset_heavy.reason: Owns and operates four sand mines, processing plants and rail-loading facilities; mining requires heavy ongoing capital investment.

big_ticket.reason: Sand is a bulk commodity bought in frequent repeat shipments by rail, truck and bulk bag.

cyclical_demand.reason: Frac sand demand depends on oil and gas drilling activity, which customers cut when prices or the economy fall.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are oil and gas exploration and production companies and pressure pumpers, plus industrial manufacturers.

notes: Website text covers only industrial products; frac sand for oil and gas is the larger part, and that comes from prior knowledge.

offers_products.reason: Sells northern white sand in grades from 8/16 to 100GFN, including custom blends and packaged bulk bags.

offers_services.reason: Also offers logistics and wellsite storage and last-mile delivery, plus in-house blending and packaging, alongside the sand.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from mined sand and from mines, plants and logistics assets, not from staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Customers repeatedly order sand under supply agreements and ongoing purchases; the site stresses consistent long-term supply.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells sand in bulk to energy companies and industrial businesses, not to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are oil and gas operators, pressure pumpers and industrial manufacturers buying sand by rail, truck and bulk bag.
